source_text: \subsection{{Exterior algebra}}\label{sec:exterior-algebra}
translated_text: \subsection{{外代数}}\label{sec:exterior-algebra}

source_text: {The primary objects of study in exterior calculus are differential $k$-forms, which we take up in the next section. These are functions whose values are alternating multilinear forms, also called algebraic $k$-forms. The exterior calculus is naturally concerned with the operations of differentiation and integration of these functions. But first we establish the basic terminology and properties of the algebraic $k$-forms which arise at each point, just as, before studying vector calculus, we must first understand finite dimensional vector spaces. This is the subject of exterior algebra, initiated by Grassman in the middle of the 19th century. Here, we briefly review the definitions and main properties, all of which are elementary.}
translated_text: {外微积分的主要研究对象是微分 $k$-形式, 下一节将讨论它们. 这些函数的值是交错多重线性形式, 也称为代数 $k$-形式. 外微积分自然涉及这些函数的微分和积分运算. 但首先需要建立每个点处出现的代数 $k$-形式的基本术语和性质, 正如在研究向量微积分之前, 必须先理解有限维向量空间一样. 这正是外代数的内容, 它由 Grassman 在 19 世纪中叶创立. 这里简要回顾其定义和主要性质, 这些都是初等的.}

source_text: \subsubsection{{Multilinear forms}}\label{subsec:multilinear-forms}
translated_text: \subsubsection{{多重线性形式}}\label{subsec:multilinear-forms}

source_text: {From the definition, the space $\operatorname{Lin}^1V$ is just the dual space $V'$. We refer to its elements as either \emph{covectors} or $1$-forms. If we choose a basis $u_1,\ldots,u_n$ of $V$ ($n=\dim V$), this induces a dual basis $u^1,\ldots,u^n$ of $V'$, defined by $u^i(u_j)=\delta_{ij}$. A general element of $\operatorname{Lin}^kV$ is determined by the value it assigns to each of the $k$-tuples $(u_{\sigma_1},\ldots,u_{\sigma_k})$ with the $\sigma_i$ integers between $1$ and $n$. Thus $\dim\operatorname{Lin}^kV=n^k$. The element of $\operatorname{Lin}^kV$ which takes the $k$-tuple $(u_{\sigma_1},\ldots,u_{\sigma_k})$ to $1$ and all the other $k$-tuples $(u_{\tau_1},\ldots,u_{\tau_k})$ to $0$ is simply $u^{\sigma_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes u^{\sigma_k}$, and so the set of all of these gives a basis for $\operatorname{Lin}^kV$.}
translated_text: {由定义, 空间 $\operatorname{Lin}^1V$ 就是对偶空间 $V'$. 其元素称为\emph{余向量}或 $1$-形式. 若选取 $V$ 的一组基 $u_1,\ldots,u_n$ ($n=\dim V$), 就诱导了 $V'$ 的对偶基 $u^1,\ldots,u^n$, 由 $u^i(u_j)=\delta_{ij}$ 定义. $\operatorname{Lin}^kV$ 的一般元素由它赋予每个 $k$ 元组 $(u_{\sigma_1},\ldots,u_{\sigma_k})$ 的值决定, 其中 $\sigma_i$ 是 $1$ 到 $n$ 之间的整数. 因此 $\dim\operatorname{Lin}^kV=n^k$. 将 $k$ 元组 $(u_{\sigma_1},\ldots,u_{\sigma_k})$ 映为 $1$, 并将所有其他 $k$ 元组 $(u_{\tau_1},\ldots,u_{\tau_k})$ 映为 $0$ 的 $\operatorname{Lin}^kV$ 元素, 就是 $u^{\sigma_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes u^{\sigma_k}$, 因而所有这些元素构成 $\operatorname{Lin}^kV$ 的一组基.}

source_text: {The case $V=\mathbb R^n$ differs from the general case only in that there is a canonical basis $e_1,\ldots,e_n$. As notation for the corresponding dual basis we use $dx^1,\ldots,dx^n$. Thus, $dx^i$ is simply the linear functional which assigns to each vector $\mathbb R^n$ its $i$th component. The reason for the odd notation ($dx^i$ rather than, say, $e^i$) will become clear as we develop exterior calculus.}
translated_text: {情形 $V=\mathbb R^n$ 与一般情形的区别, 仅在于它具有典范基 $e_1,\ldots,e_n$. 相应对偶基记作 $dx^1,\ldots,dx^n$. 因此, $dx^i$ 就是将 $\mathbb R^n$ 中每个向量映为其第 $i$ 个分量的线性泛函. 随着外微积分的展开, 采用这一特别记号 ($dx^i$ 而不是例如 $e^i$) 的原因将变得清楚.}

source_text: \subsubsection{{Alternating multilinear forms}}\label{subsec:alternating-multilinear-forms}
translated_text: \subsubsection{{交错多重线性形式}}\label{subsec:alternating-multilinear-forms}

source_text: {We define the space $\operatorname{Alt}^kV$ as the space of all skew-symmetric $k$-linear forms. The spaces $\operatorname{Alt}^0V$ and $\operatorname{Alt}^1V$ coincide with $\operatorname{Lin}^0V$ and $\operatorname{Lin}^1V$, i.e., are just the space of scalars and the space of covectors, respectively. An element of $\operatorname{Alt}^kV$ is determined by the value it assigns to each of the $k$-tuples $(e_{\sigma_1},\ldots,e_{\sigma_k})$ with $1\leq\sigma_1<\cdots<\sigma_k\leq n$, so $\dim\operatorname{Alt}^kV=\binom nk$. For $k>n$, $\operatorname{Alt}^kV=0$.}
translated_text: {将空间 $\operatorname{Alt}^kV$ 定义为所有反对称 $k$-线性形式构成的空间. 空间 $\operatorname{Alt}^0V$ 和 $\operatorname{Alt}^1V$ 分别与 $\operatorname{Lin}^0V$ 和 $\operatorname{Lin}^1V$ 一致, 即分别是标量空间和余向量空间. $\operatorname{Alt}^kV$ 的一个元素, 由它赋予满足 $1\leq\sigma_1<\cdots<\sigma_k\leq n$ 的每个 $k$ 元组 $(e_{\sigma_1},\ldots,e_{\sigma_k})$ 的值决定, 所以 $\dim\operatorname{Alt}^kV=\binom nk$. 当 $k>n$ 时, $\operatorname{Alt}^kV=0$.}

source_text:
{The \emph{exterior product} or \emph{wedge product} of $\omega\in\operatorname{Alt}^jV$ and $\mu\in\operatorname{Alt}^kV$ is given by}
\[
(\omega\wedge\mu)(v_1,\ldots,v_{j+k})=\sum_\sigma\operatorname{sign}(\sigma)\omega(v_{\sigma_1},\ldots,v_{\sigma_j})\mu(v_{\sigma_{j+1}},\ldots,v_{\sigma_{j+k}}),
\]
{where the sum is over $\sigma\in\Sigma_{j+k}$ for which $\sigma_1<\cdots<\sigma_j$ and $\sigma_{j+1}<\cdots<\sigma_{j+k}$. Equivalently,}
\[
\omega\wedge\mu=\binom{j+k}j\operatorname{skw}(\omega\otimes\mu).
\]
{The exterior product satisfies the anticommutativity law}
\[
\omega\wedge\mu=(-)^{jk}\mu\wedge\omega,\qquad\omega\in\operatorname{Alt}^jV,\ \mu\in\operatorname{Alt}^kV.
\]
translated_text:
{$\omega\in\operatorname{Alt}^jV$ 和 $\mu\in\operatorname{Alt}^kV$ 的\emph{外积}或\emph{楔积}由下式给出:}
\[
(\omega\wedge\mu)(v_1,\ldots,v_{j+k})=\sum_\sigma\operatorname{sign}(\sigma)\omega(v_{\sigma_1},\ldots,v_{\sigma_j})\mu(v_{\sigma_{j+1}},\ldots,v_{\sigma_{j+k}}),
\]
{其中对满足 $\sigma_1<\cdots<\sigma_j$ 和 $\sigma_{j+1}<\cdots<\sigma_{j+k}$ 的 $\sigma\in\Sigma_{j+k}$ 求和. 等价地,}
\[
\omega\wedge\mu=\binom{j+k}j\operatorname{skw}(\omega\otimes\mu).
\]
{外积满足反交换律}
\[
\omega\wedge\mu=(-)^{jk}\mu\wedge\omega,\qquad\omega\in\operatorname{Alt}^jV,\ \mu\in\operatorname{Alt}^kV.
\]

source_text: \subsubsection{{Operations on alternating forms}}\label{subsec:alternating-form-operations}
translated_text: \subsubsection{{交错形式上的运算}}\label{subsec:alternating-form-operations}

source_text:
\medskip\noindent\textbf{{Volume form}}\par
{When $k$ is equal to the dimension $n$ of $V$, the space $\operatorname{Alt}^nV$ is one-dimensional, and so a basis consists of a single element. If the space $V$ is endowed with both an inner product and an \emph{orientation}, then there is a canonical choice of basis element. The ordered bases of a finite dimensional vector space $V$ divide into two classes according to whether the change-of-basis matrix connecting two of them has a positive or negative determinant. We orient the vector space by designating the ordered bases of one class as the positively oriented ones. (In $\mathbb R^3$, it is conventional to take as the positively oriented bases those which satisfy the "right-hand rule.") If $\omega\in\operatorname{Alt}^nV$, then the value of $\omega(u_1,\ldots,u_n)$ is the same for any orthonormal positively oriented basis $u_1,\ldots,u_n$, and we determine a unique element of $\operatorname{Alt}^nV$ by requiring this value to be $1$. The resulting alternating $n$-form is called the \emph{volume form} on $V$, which we typically denote by $\operatorname{vol}$. It may be expressed in terms of the dual basis to any positively oriented orthonormal basis as $\operatorname{vol}=u^1\wedge\cdots\wedge u^n$. On $\mathbb R^n$, the canonical basis $e_1,\ldots,e_n$ is orthonormal and positively oriented, so}
\[
\operatorname{vol}=dx^1\wedge\cdots\wedge dx^n.
\]
translated_text:
\medskip\noindent\textbf{{体积形式}}\par
{当 $k$ 等于 $V$ 的维数 $n$ 时, 空间 $\operatorname{Alt}^nV$ 是一维的, 因而一组基只包含一个元素. 若空间 $V$ 既赋有内积又赋有\emph{定向}, 就有典范的基元素选取. 有限维向量空间 $V$ 的有序基分为两类, 取决于连接其中两组基的换基矩阵的行列式为正还是为负. 指定其中一类的有序基为正向基, 就给向量空间定了向. (在 $\mathbb R^3$ 中, 习惯上将满足"右手法则"的基取为正向基.) 若 $\omega\in\operatorname{Alt}^nV$, 则对任意标准正交正向基 $u_1,\ldots,u_n$, $\omega(u_1,\ldots,u_n)$ 的值相同; 要求此值为 $1$, 就唯一确定了 $\operatorname{Alt}^nV$ 的一个元素. 得到的交错 $n$-形式称为 $V$ 上的\emph{体积形式}, 通常记为 $\operatorname{vol}$. 它可用任意正向标准正交基的对偶基写成 $\operatorname{vol}=u^1\wedge\cdots\wedge u^n$. 在 $\mathbb R^n$ 上, 典范基 $e_1,\ldots,e_n$ 标准正交且正向, 所以}
\[
\operatorname{vol}=dx^1\wedge\cdots\wedge dx^n.
\]

source_text:
\medskip\noindent\textbf{{Scalar and vector proxies}}\par
{If $V$ is an oriented inner product space of dimension $n$, then there is a natural isomorphism of each of the spaces $\operatorname{Alt}^0V$ and $\operatorname{Alt}^nV$ onto the scalar space $\mathbb R$, and of each of the spaces $\operatorname{Alt}^1V$ and $\operatorname{Alt}^{n-1}V$ onto the vector space $V$. In this way we can associate either a \emph{scalar proxy} or a \emph{vector proxy} to each member of $\operatorname{Alt}^kV$ for $k=0$, $1$, $n-1$, or $n$ (and so for all cases if $\dim V\leq3$). We now describe these isomorphisms.}
translated_text:
\medskip\noindent\textbf{{标量代理和向量代理}}\par
{若 $V$ 是维数为 $n$ 的有定向内积空间, 则空间 $\operatorname{Alt}^0V$ 和 $\operatorname{Alt}^nV$ 各自与标量空间 $\mathbb R$ 之间存在自然同构, 空间 $\operatorname{Alt}^1V$ 和 $\operatorname{Alt}^{n-1}V$ 各自与向量空间 $V$ 之间也存在自然同构. 由此, 当 $k=0$, $1$, $n-1$ 或 $n$ 时 (因而在 $\dim V\leq3$ 时涵盖所有情形), 可为 $\operatorname{Alt}^kV$ 的每个元素关联一个\emph{标量代理}或\emph{向量代理}. 现在描述这些同构.}

source_text: {For any vector space $V$, $\operatorname{Alt}^0V$ is just the space $\mathbb R$ of scalars and the isomorphism is the identity. The inner product on $V$ defines the isomorphism of $\operatorname{Alt}^1V=V'$ onto $V$ via the Riesz representation. The Hodge star then maps $\operatorname{Alt}^{n-1}V$ isomorphically to $\operatorname{Alt}^1V$ (which is isomorphic to $V$) and similarly maps $\operatorname{Alt}^nV$ to $\operatorname{Alt}^0V=\mathbb R$.}
translated_text: {对任意向量空间 $V$, $\operatorname{Alt}^0V$ 就是标量空间 $\mathbb R$, 相应同构为恒等映射. $V$ 上的内积通过 Riesz 表示定义了从 $\operatorname{Alt}^1V=V'$ 到 $V$ 上的同构. 随后, Hodge 星算子将 $\operatorname{Alt}^{n-1}V$ 同构地映到 $\operatorname{Alt}^1V$ (后者与 $V$ 同构), 并类似地将 $\operatorname{Alt}^nV$ 映到 $\operatorname{Alt}^0V=\mathbb R$.}

source_text: {The case $n=2$ is particular, since in that case we have two ways of associating a vector proxy with an alternating $1$-form: either as a $1$-form by applying the Riesz map or as an $(n-1)$-form, that is, by applying first the Hodge star and then the Riesz map. These do not coincide, since the Hodge star $\operatorname{Alt}^1V\to\operatorname{Alt}^1V$ is not the identity map: it takes $u^1$ to $u^2$ and $u^2$ to $-u^1$. Therefore the two vector proxies differ by a rotation through a right angle.}
translated_text: {情形 $n=2$ 比较特殊, 因为此时有两种方式将向量代理与交错 $1$-形式关联: 或者将它视为 $1$-形式并应用 Riesz 映射, 或者视为 $(n-1)$-形式, 即先应用 Hodge 星算子再应用 Riesz 映射. 这两种方式并不一致, 因为 Hodge 星算子 $\operatorname{Alt}^1V\to\operatorname{Alt}^1V$ 不是恒等映射: 它将 $u^1$ 映为 $u^2$, 将 $u^2$ 映为 $-u^1$. 因此, 两个向量代理相差一个直角旋转.}

source_text:
\medskip\noindent\textbf{{Exterior algebra of $\mathbb R^3$}}\par
{Since the spaces $\operatorname{Alt}^0\mathbb R^n$ and $\operatorname{Alt}^n\mathbb R^n$ may be identified with $\mathbb R$ and the spaces $\operatorname{Alt}^1\mathbb R^n$ and $\operatorname{Alt}^{n-1}\mathbb R^n$ with $\mathbb R^n$, in the case of $n=3$ (or fewer) dimensions, all the operations of exterior algebra may be viewed as operations on scalars or vectors. These operations are tabulated in Table~\ref{tab:exterior-algebra-r3}, which is adapted from \BookCite{11}. We remark that the matrix $(\det L)L^{-1}$ which shows up as the pullback of a $2$-form in the penultimate line of the table is the adjugate matrix of $L$, which is defined (as the transpose of the cofactor matrix) even when $L$ is singular.}
translated_text:
\medskip\noindent\textbf{{$\mathbb R^3$ 的外代数}}\par
{由于空间 $\operatorname{Alt}^0\mathbb R^n$ 和 $\operatorname{Alt}^n\mathbb R^n$ 可与 $\mathbb R$ 等同, 空间 $\operatorname{Alt}^1\mathbb R^n$ 和 $\operatorname{Alt}^{n-1}\mathbb R^n$ 可与 $\mathbb R^n$ 等同, 在 $n=3$ (或更低) 维时, 外代数的所有运算都可视为标量或向量上的运算. Table~\ref{tab:exterior-algebra-r3} 列出了这些运算, 该表改编自 \BookCite{11}. 注意, 表中倒数第二行作为 $2$-形式拉回出现的矩阵 $(\det L)L^{-1}$ 是 $L$ 的伴随矩阵, 即使 $L$ 奇异, 它也可定义为代数余子式矩阵的转置.}
